plugins.name: dev-copilot
plugins.description: Development co-pilot for any repo, with built-in World of Warcraft addon support. Every command detects the repo it runs in (dev-copilot-profile) and applies generic behavior, or the full Ka0s WoW Addon Standard behavior via WoW overlays in WoW addon, LibKa0s, WowAddonStandards and tooling repos. Shared: git diff/commit (opt-in push), documentation drift sync, a measure-first principal-engineer review subagent, test running, gated version bumping, changeset finalizing, execution-status reporting, and a GitHub-issue workflow keyed on state:/severity: labels (audit, triage, add, fetch, details, summary). WoW-only (wow-*): standard-compliant addon scaffolding, standards compliance auditing (subagent), standards-reference revendoring and cross-repo harvesting, LibKa0s re-vendoring with new-surface adoption, interface-version bumping, four-suite automated-test recording, in-game perf-run analysis, and a CurseForge journal of each addon's releases, download counts and classified comments. Hooks: line-ending normalization from .gitattributes and a bounded-runs guard for heavy Lua test runs. Successor to the wow-addon plugin.
